name: learning-rl
description: Learning RL bridge service (W047): the PURE bridge between the recorded empirical chain (W037 trajectories + W036 evaluations + W038 experiment evaluations + W044 world-agent bindings) and the RL trainer surface (rl-protocol). assembleEpisodes is THE GATE: every trajectory re-proven through W037's own validator (errors carried verbatim), every binding through W044's own, scope/world/session agreement proven pairwise (an episode's agent identity routes through a proven binding), every experiment-evaluation summary proven a faithful carry of the record's own W036 evaluation (carry never re-scores, but a carry mismatch is fail-closed), and every reward signal proven constraint-aware — a bare-P&L reward is the loud typed refusal naming the §13 sole-P&L law. assembleBatch builds the deterministic, content-addressed episode batch (canonical order, declared selection policy as DATA). NEVER executes a trainer, never steps a world, never trains anything (A14; R054: RL is ONE learning method — W048 owns distributed episode generation, W049 owns the JAX training adapter).
